skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply single and multiple regression models, including Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) estimation.
Conduct hypothesis testing and calculate confidence intervals for econometric models.
Evaluate econometric models using various diagnostic tests such as multicollinearity, autocorrelation, and non-normal errors.
Apply basic time series analysis techniques to econometric models.
Use statistical software like EViews and R for econometric analysis.
